title: Captain Phasma
subtitle: Chrome Dome
text: Action [Exhaust]: If you played a First Order card this phase, deal 1 damage to a base.
deployBox: On Attack: If you played another First Order card this phase, you may deal 1 damage to a unit. If you do, deal 1 damage to a base.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules: Phasma’s leader ability still can be used as an action even if you haven't played a First Order card this phase (but no damage is dealt).
